magmatic.label: Eocene-magmatic Carlin-type
magmatic.use_when: Ore sits near intrusions or volcanics of the same age as mineralization (Nevada Eocene belt: dated igneous rocks within a few km of ore).

magma_poor.label: Magma-poor Carlin-type
magma_poor.use_when: Little or no magmatic input is documented: ore controlled by structure and reactive carbonate or carbonaceous host with no age-matched intrusions nearby (for example Yukon Rackla belt).

older_buried.label: Older-intrusion / buried-pluton Carlin-type
older_buried.use_when: Mineralization is linked to older (for example Jurassic-Cretaceous) or buried intrusions rather than an age-matched belt.

caveat: Magma-poor and older/buried families have only 18 and 12 deposits. Their forests are thin; treat results as indicative and read them with the within-family cross-validation in tests/archetype_cv_results.csv.
